rationale: Both are technically deep and independently rediscover the legacy-vs-distilled num_steps unit mismatch, but Y lands the sharper, more grounded catch: in combined mode the schedule was fixed to be per-partition (per the actual ground-truth fix) yet video/audio shift scales are still sourced only from the FL2VA release and applied to a distilled Ref2VA schedule — this directly extends the PR's core partition-scoping theme that the human reviewers flagged. X's package-location complaint (arguing sigma_schedule.py shouldn't live in diffusion/sched) actually contradicts the documented reviewer decision to move it there, and its precise import-timing benchmark numbers look unverified/fabricated, both hurting precision. X is slightly more readable and better organized with clear Major/Medium/Minor triage, but Y's evidence-quoted claims are more consistently verified against the code.
